greek: Καὶ συνήθροισεν Μωυσῆς πᾶσαν συναγωγὴν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι, οὓς εἶπεν κύριος ποιῆσαι αὐτούς.
hint: Moses assembles all Israel to hear what the Lord commands.

notes.text: συναθροίζω, to gather together, assemble; its examples' collected amounts and has not joined set aside.
A verbless clause: these the words.

reading: And [[gathered together|gathered together and assembled|συναθροίζω]] [[name:Μωυσῆς]] [[all|all, the whole, every, every single|πᾶς]] [[bringing together|bringing together and uniting, place of assembly and synagogue, drawing together and contracting, forming in column, pursing up, wrinkling, collection, conclusion and inference|συναγωγή]] of sons of [[name:Ισραηλ]] and [[said|said, spoke, declared, called by name, told|λέγω]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] them [[these|these, the nearer, what follows|οὗτος]] [[the words|the words, the language and talk, the sayings and statements, the speech and discourse|λόγος]], which [[said|said, spoke, declared, called by name, told|λέγω]] [[lord|lord, master, the one having power and authority over|κύριος]] [[to make|to make, to do, to produce, to create|ποιέω]] them.

names.gloss: (Μωυσῆς, from Hebrew Mōšeh, which the Hebrew of 2:10 hears in māšâ, "to draw out")
(Ισραηλ, from Hebrew Yiśrāʾēl, which the Hebrew of Genesis 32:29 hears in śārâ ʿim ʾĕlōhîm, "he strove with God")

greek: ἓξ ἡμέρας ποιήσεις ἔργα, τῇ δὲ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ κατάπαυσις, ἅγιον, σάββατα, ἀνάπαυσις κυρίῳ· πᾶς ὁ ποιῶν ἔργον ἐν αὐτῇ τελευτάτω.
hint: Six days for work; the seventh is a holy rest, and whoever works on it dies.

notes.text: κατάπαυσις, a putting to rest, a putting down, a cessation, calm.
τελευτάω, the present imperative: let complete, let end, the chain of the corpus; here, let him die.

reading: six [[days|days, day-breaks, times|ἡμέρα]] [[you will make|you will make, you will do, you will produce, you will create|ποιέω]] [[works|works, business, deeds|ἔργον]], [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[to the day|to the day, to the day-break, to the time|ἡμέρα]] [[to the seventh|to the seventh, to the seventh day|ἕβδομος]] [[a putting to rest|a putting to rest and a putting down and deposing, a cessation and calm|κατάπαυσις]], [[devoted to the gods|devoted to the gods and sacred and holy, holy and pure|ἅγιος]], [[sabbaths|sabbaths, rests, periods of seven days and weeks|σάββατον]], [[repose|repose, rest, relaxation and recreation, rest from|ἀνάπαυσις]] [[to lord|to lord, to master, to the one having power and authority over|κύριος]]; [[all|all, the whole, every, every single|πᾶς]] [[the one making|the one making, the one doing, the one producing, the one creating|ποιέω]] [[work|work, business, deeds, action, works of industry and tilled lands|ἔργον]] [[in|within, inside of, and by means of|ἐν]] to her [[let complete|let complete, let finish, let accomplish, let fulfil, let bring about, let bring to an end, let make an end of, let end life and die, let come to an end|τελευτάω]].

greek: οὐ καύσετε πῦρ ἐν πάσῃ κατοικίᾳ ὑμῶν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων· ἐγὼ κύριος.
hint: No fire is to be lit in any dwelling on the sabbath.

notes.text: κατοικία, a settlement, colony, the foundation of a colony.
καίω, the future, you will light, kindle, set on fire.

reading: not [[you will light|you will light and kindle, you will set on fire and burn up and burn, you will burn and scorch, you will burn and destroy, you will cauterise|καίω]] [[fire|fire, the funeral-fire, the fire of the hearth|πῦρ]] [[in all|within, inside of, and by means of all, the whole, every, every single|ἐν; πᾶς]] [[to a settlement|to a settlement and colony and the foundation of a colony|κατοικία]] of you [[to the day|to the day, to the day-break, to the time|ἡμέρα]] [[of the sabbaths|of the sabbaths, of the rests, of the periods of seven days and weeks|σάββατον]]; I [[lord|lord, master, the one having power and authority over|κύριος]].

greek: Καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς πᾶσαν συναγωγὴν υἱῶν Ισραηλ λέγων Τοῦτο τὸ ῥῆμα, ὃ συνέταξεν κύριος λέγων
hint: Moses tells the assembly what the Lord has ordered.

notes.text: The nominative, standing before the command it introduces.

greek: Λάβετε παρʼ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν ἀφαίρεμα κυρίῳ· πᾶς ὁ καταδεχόμενος τῇ καρδίᾳ οἴσουσιν τὰς ἀπαρχὰς κυρίῳ, χρυσίον, ἀργύριον, χαλκόν,
hint: Everyone willing is to bring an offering: gold, silver, bronze.

notes.text: The singular subject with a plural verb.

greek: καὶ λίθους σαρδίου καὶ λίθους εἰς τὴν γλυφὴν εἰς τὴν ἐπωμίδα καὶ τὸν ποδήρη.

notes.text: Rahlfs prints no 35:8; the verse numbers run from 7 to 9. The Hebrew's verse 8, oil for the light and spices, is not in this text.

greek: καὶ πᾶς σοφὸς τῇ καρδίᾳ ἐν ὑμῖν ἐλθὼν ἐργαζέσθω πάντα, ὅσα συνέταξεν κύριος·
hint: Every skilled person is to come and make what the Lord has commanded.

ἐργάζομαι, the present imperative, let work.

notes.text: παράρρυμα, anything drawn along the side, a leathern or hair curtain stretched along the sides of ships, restored whole (MARKUP_LOST).

hint: Silver, bronze and acacia wood are brought as offerings.

notes.text: The verb with its own noun, taking from that which is taken away as the choice part.

hint: Skilled women spin and bring blue, purple, scarlet and linen yarn.

notes.text: νήθω and νέω, to spin, one translation each, plain text.

reading: and [[all|all, the whole, every, every single|πᾶς]] [[woman|woman, mistress and lady, wife and spouse, mortal woman|γυνή]] [[skilled in any handicraft|skilled in any handicraft or art and cunning in their craft, clever in matters of common life and wise and prudent and shrewd, skilled in the sciences and learned and profound and wise, the abstruse and obscure, the cleverly devised and wise, the too clever|σοφός]] [[to the thought|to the thought, to the intention and purpose, to the notion and opinion, to the intelligence and understanding, to the meaning|διάνοια]] [[to the hands|to the hands, to the hands and arms, to the arms|χείρ]] to spin [[bore|bore, carried, bore along, endured and suffered, brought and fetched, brought and offered and presented|φέρω]] having been spun, [[the hyacinth|the hyacinth, the sapphire|ὑάκινθος]] and [[the purple-fish|the purple-fish, the purple dye and purple, the purple raiment|πορφύρα]] and the scarlet and [[the fine flax|the fine flax, the linen made from it|βύσσος]];

greek: καὶ τὰς συνθέσεις καὶ τὸ ἔλαιον τῆς χρίσεως καὶ τὴν σύνθεσιν τοῦ θυμιάματος.
hint: The leaders also bring spices, the anointing oil and the incense blend.

notes.text: σύνθεσις, the plural, the puttings together, compositions.

notes.text: The accusative participle, having gone in, with no noun of its own in this case.
